scenes.heading: 🦁 GUESS THE ANIMAL!
scenes.narration: Hello Little Explorers! Listen carefully. Who makes this super loud sound?
scenes.subtitles: Can you guess who makes this sound?

scenes.heading: 🔊 LISTEN CLOSELY...
scenes.narration: ROOAAR! ROOAAR! Did you hear that? Who has a golden mane and says ROAR?
Counting down! Three! Two! One! Say it with me!

scenes.heading: 🎉 IT'S A LION! 🦁
scenes.narration: It's Leo the King of the Jungle! A brave and happy lion! Great job, little superstar!
scenes.subtitles: Yay! It's Leo the friendly Lion! 🌟
